patterns.name: Stash Gate
patterns.desc: Opens my Pocket Stash, a personal chest bound to my soul that I can reach from anywhere.

patterns.name: Stash Offering
patterns.desc: Moves the given item entity into my Pocket Stash. Whatever does not fit stays where it was.

patterns.name: Summon Illusion
patterns.desc: Creates my personal Illusion where I stand and pushes it. I may only have one; a new one replaces the old. It cannot be hurt and nothing collides with it, but hostile creatures chasing me may turn on it instead. It vanishes if I change dimension, leave the world, or dispel it.

patterns.name: Dispel Illusion
patterns.desc: Dispels my Illusion, if I have one.

patterns.name: Illusion Swap
patterns.desc: Instantly swaps my position with my Illusion's. The farther it is, the more media it costs, and beyond a certain range the swap fails.

patterns.name: Rune of Waiting
patterns.desc: Pauses the hex for the given number of seconds (at most a minute), then carries on with the same stack. Leaving the world cancels the rest of the hex.

patterns.name: Open Media Rift
patterns.desc: Tears open a rift into media itself and hands me a Quantum Phial bound to me. Any phial I made before stops working, though the media stored in it is not lost.

patterns.name: Phial Infusion
patterns.desc: With my Quantum Phial in my other hand, dissolves an amethyst item entity (dust, shards, charged crystals, blocks, clusters or buds) into the phial at the usual rate.

patterns.name: Phial Reflection
patterns.desc: Pushes how much media my Quantum Phial holds, in units of amethyst dust.

patterns.name: Quantum Shift
patterns.desc: For the given number of seconds I slip partly out of the world: I walk through walls, though floors still hold me unless I crouch. Creatures ignore me, projectiles pass through me and nothing can hurt me, but I cannot strike or touch the world. I can still cast. Casting it again ends the shift early, with no refund. If it ends inside a block I am pushed to the nearest free space.

patterns.name: Delayed Echo
patterns.desc: Leaves an intangible echo of myself here. After the given number of seconds it casts the given hex once from its own position, with itself on the stack, paid for with my media.

patterns.name: Personal Echo
patterns.desc: Leaves a motionless echo of myself here as a decoy. It has a single point of health.

patterns.name: Cyclic Echo
patterns.desc: Creates an echo that endlessly retraces my last few seconds of movement, returning to the start each time. It dies in one hit.

patterns.name: Cyclic Wisp
patterns.desc: Summons a wisp at the given position that casts the hex every given number of seconds, the given number of times, with itself on the stack. Each run costs me a little media on top of the hex itself.

patterns.name: Projectile Wisp
patterns.desc: Fires a wisp from my eyes with the given velocity (its length is the speed). When it strikes something it casts the hex there, with the entity it hit, or the centre of the block it hit, on the stack.

patterns.name: Shared Damage
patterns.desc: Binds the given creatures with a magical beam: whenever one is hurt, every other one takes the same damage.

patterns.name: Distributed Damage
patterns.desc: Binds the given creatures with a magical beam: damage dealt to any of them is split evenly among all the living ones. When one dies, the rest share the burden.

patterns.name: Phantom Mob
patterns.desc: Conjures a see-through phantom of the given creature's kind at the given position. It behaves normally, but has half the health and deals half the damage. A phantom creeper's blast is weak and breaks nothing. Phantoms leave nothing behind.

patterns.name: Empowered Phantom Mob
patterns.desc: Like Phantom Mob, but the phantom is solid, at full strength, and betrayed only by faint particles. Whenever someone strikes or uses it, the given hex is cast as me from where it stands, with them on the stack.

patterns.name: Phantom Block
patterns.desc: Places a phantom copy of the block at the first position at the second. It looks and feels real, but vanishes the moment anyone touches it.

patterns.name: Empowered Phantom Block
patterns.desc: Like Phantom Block, but instead of vanishing it casts the given hex as me whenever it is touched, with whoever touched it on the stack.

patterns.name: Phantom Item
patterns.desc: Drops a phantom copy of the given item entity's stack at the given position. It vanishes when someone tries to pick it up.

patterns.name: Empowered Phantom Item
patterns.desc: Like Phantom Item, but picking it up also casts the given hex as me, with the picker on the stack.

patterns.name: Phantom Vault Gate
patterns.desc: Lets me look into my Phantom Vault. Phantom items cannot be taken out by hand.

patterns.name: Phantom Vault Offering
patterns.desc: Moves the given phantom item into my Phantom Vault, where it keeps without fading. An empowered phantom loses its hex.

patterns.name: Phantom Vault Release
patterns.desc: Releases the phantom item in the given slot of my Phantom Vault (0 to 26) at the given position, and pushes it.

patterns.name: Pocket Dimension
patterns.desc: Steps me onto my own platform in the pocket dimension, isolated from everyone else's. The place I left from is remembered.

patterns.name: Exit Anchor
patterns.desc: Pushes the dimension and position I last entered my pocket from, or two nulls if I never have. It only reads; nothing moves.

patterns.name: Mirror Optics
patterns.desc: For the given number of seconds, the given player sees a second, upside-down copy of the world mirrored at eye level. It is only light: nothing there can be touched.

patterns.name: Shifted Optics
patterns.desc: For the given number of seconds, the given player's view is displaced by the given offset. They aim and interact from where they seem to be, not from where they are.
